description: This file contains a C source implementation for a utility function that converts a variable-length unsigned character array to a 32-bit unsigned integer, specifically within a Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) context. The primary function, SlapVcoUcharArrayToUint32, interprets the byte array depending on its length (1, 2, or 4 bytes) and returns the corresponding integer value.

methods.name: SLAP_UINT32 SlapVcoUcharArrayToUint32(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_UCHAR_ARRAY * var_uchar_array)
methods.description: Converts a variable-length unsigned character array to a 32-bit unsigned integer based on its length (1, 2, or 4 bytes). It reads the appropriate number of bytes and interprets them as an unsigned integer, returning 0 for null input or unsupported sizes.
